instruction: With both arms, lift the two far corners of the towel and fold them onto the two near corners (half fold), then let go.

outcome.real_measurement: Left fold: horizontal distance between the far-left and near-left corners < 8 cm at every judged step (same threshold as towel_fold_diagonal v1/v3). Real world: top camera, marked corners, table-plane homography.
Right fold: far-right to near-right corner distance < 8 cm at every judged step. Real world: as above.
Footprint (convex hull of the top-down projection / area at reset) < 0.70 at every judged step (towel v1/v3 threshold; an ideal half fold gives 0.5). Real world: towel segmentation area.
<= 2 % of the towel above 5 cm at every judged step (towel v1/v3). Real world: side / depth camera.

Lifted (process term, new): at some step of the episode the far-left corner region (3 x 3 vertices at the corner) was >= 5 cm above the table, so a fold made by dragging the corner along the table does not pass. Real world: side camera / depth, corner marker height.
Lifted: the far-right corner region was >= 5 cm above the table at some step. Real world: as above.

Consequence test after the judged window (v3.2, E24c fix 2): every arm whose gripper is within 3 cm of any towel particle backs its TCP off 3 cm along its approach axis in 0.5 s with its last gripper command, then holds 0.5 s; the largest displacement of the towel particles that were within 5 cm of a retracting gripper must be <= 1 cm (a pinched towel is lifted with the gripper); 0 when no arm is within 3 cm (nothing retracts). Real world: same motion, depth camera on the gripper's region.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: both arms lift the far corners, carry them over the near corners, lower, release, retreat

counterexamples.name: drop_midway
counterexamples.description: both grippers open halfway through the carry

counterexamples.name: drag_on_ground
counterexamples.description: grip and drag both far corners to the near corners without lifting

source.derived_from: imsim/imsim/soft/contracts/dual_towel_fold_v1.json (frozen E23 2026-11-15; unchanged): revision v2 with the E24c fixes that apply to cloth
source.engine: newton-1.7.0 VBD cloth; robots SAPIEN 3.0.3 / PhysX (E20 route A, one-way bridge)
source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 for cloth: position-based quiescence speed, 5 s settle cap, retreat aftermath over the towel particles (imsim/imsim/soft_eval.py)

notes: v2 = v1 with three changes (E24c red-team fixes): (1) settle.max_seconds 3 -> 5 s; (2) quiescence speed signal cloth_speed_p95 (VBD particle velocity = position change over one 1/600 s substep) -> cloth_speed_p95_pos (95th percentile over the particles of |x(t) - x(t-1)| / control_dt, positions of consecutive control steps), same 0.1 m/s bound; (3) NEW outcome term aftermath.retreat_object_disp <= 1 cm (largest displacement of the towel particles within 5 cm of a retracting gripper while every arm within 3 cm of the towel backs off 3 cm with its last gripper command; 0 when no arm is that close; the rest of the towel is not measured because a folded towel still creeps by up to ~2.8 cm within the 1.5 s aftermath after the v1 quiescence rule is met - measured in the E29b expert pilot with no arm near). Everything else (the six v1 outcome terms, release rule over particles, quiet corner displacement 3 mm / 10 steps, robot speed, counterexamples) is unchanged. v1 notes: Signals (DualFoldTowelEnv.cloth_signals, per world): towel_dist_L/R = |FL-NL|_xy, |FR-NR|_xy; towel_footprint_ratio by the recorder (veritask scipy hull); towel_frac_above_5cm (GPU); towel_lift_L/R = highest vertex of the 3x3 patch at the far corner; robot_cloth_impulse = VBD contact force x dt over every robot collider (both arms) summed over the substeps of a control step; finger_cloth_enclosure = smallest over the two grippers of the sum of the two pads' clearances to the nearest particle between the pads (1 m when none); cloth_speed_p95; towel_<corner>_<xyz>; robot_qvel_max = largest arm joint speed of both arms. Hold A = both arms held at the joint positions reached, grippers keep their last target. No retreat aftermath (the release rule over particles is used, as in the towel v3 binding).
